texts.0e21c8e7bf5e: The data supplied by the NHS IC to University of Oxford will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project identified above.
texts.c5f04122f348: The principal aim of this research is to obtain reliable information on the risk of breast cancer associated with the use of hormone replacement therapy (HRT). This is an important question because almost one third of women aged 50-64 in Britain are currently using hormone replacment therapy and breast cancer is the most common cancer in women. Therefore even a small increase in the relative risk of breast cancer associated with HRT use would affect large numbers of women.
